metadata.selection: A 250-card study pack for each level, ordered by official syllabus sequence. Level 2 contains all 204 newly assigned Level-2 entries plus 46 Level-1 review entries because the official HSK 3.1 syllabus has only 204 new entries at Level 2. Levels 7–9 are an official combined advanced band.
